sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has been incarcerated since 21.03.2023 and has undergone actual period of 01 year, 10 months and 10 days, as an under trial.
The investigation is complete; challan was presented on 14.06.2023.

It is further submitted 1 of 3 Neutral Citation No:=2025:PHHC:019512 that co-accused Vishnu @ Dev has been granted the concession of bail by the trial Court vide order dated 24.04.2023 (Annexure P-2).
Thus, no useful purpose would be served by keeping the petitioner behind bars for an indefinite period.
3. On the other hand, learned State counsel has opposed the present petition while placing on record custody certificate dated 06.02.2025.

Learned State counsel would refer to the status report dated 16.01.2025 to submit that the trial is at fag end as all the prosecution witnesses have since been examined in this case and now the case is fixed for defence evidence and arguments.
Reliance is placed on the zimni orders passed by the trial Court.

Learned State counsel further submits that as per the custody certificate, petitioner is involved in one other criminal case and four complaint cases under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act.

4. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and considered the rival contentions.
5.

Perusal of the zimni orders passed by the trial Court would show that statement of the petitioner/accused under Section 313 Cr.P.C. was recorded on 06.08.2024 and thereafter, the case is being adjourned time and again at request of petitioner/accused inasmuch as 13 consecutive adjournments have been sought for the purpose of defence evidence.
However, till 04.02.2025, no defence witness has been examined on behalf of the petitioner.

6. Keeping in view the above facts and circumstances, no 2 of 3 Neutral Citation No:=2025:PHHC:019512 ground for grant of regular bail to the petitioner during pendency of trial is made out at this stage.
Accordingly, the present petition is dismissed.
7. However, the trial Court is directed to make earnest efforts to conclude the trial expeditiously.
(VIKAS SURI)
February 10, 2025 JUDGE
